backend/main.mo: Defines the main backend actor with access control, content types, user settings, moderation structures, and profile retrieval.
feature_evidence.json: Contains feature evidence entries mapping features to affected files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists summarized descriptions of many frontend source files and their functionality.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind CSS variables and themes for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML entrypoint loading the app icon, fonts, and React bundle.
frontend/public/mobile/MOBILE_BUILD.md: Provides build instructions and prerequisites for generating Android APK and iOS IPA files.
Explains mobile wrapper branding assets and structure for Android and iOS projects.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the main router, layout, and route definitions including the new /downloads page.
frontend/src/components/auth/AccessDenie: Displays an access-denied message with navigation back to home.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button handling Internet Identity login/logout with loading states.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAdmi: Wrapper component enforcing admin-only access with loading, login, and denial states.
frontend/src/components/confessions/Conf: Displays a confession with timestamp and a report button, opening a reporting dialog.
frontend/src/components/layout/BottomNav: Renders a fixed bottom navigation bar with route-aware active tabs.
frontend/src/components/layout/MobileSca: Provides a mobile layout with header, scrollable content area, and bottom navigation.
frontend/src/components/moderation/Repor: Modal dialog allowing users to submit content reports with a reason and optional note.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Quick: Interactive multi-step onboarding tour explaining app features and navigation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity, refreshing dependent queries when it changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useComplianceGate.ts: Tracks whether the user accepted compliance terms using local storage.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth state, login/logout handling, and stored identity restoration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating confessions, profiles, moderation data, and admin checks.
frontend/src/hooks/useQuickTour.ts: Manages quick‑tour completion state via local storage.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, global styles, and extensive light/dark theme CSS variables plus gradient button components.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/chat/EncryptedChatEnt: Displays an entry screen for a future encrypted chat, showing match info and placeholder messaging UI.
frontend/src/pages/confessions/Confessio: Displays approved confessions, handling loading, errors, and navigation to create new confessions.
frontend/src/pages/confessions/NewConfes: Form for submitting a new anonymous confession with validation and mutation submission.
frontend/src/pages/discussions/Discussio: Shows discussion categories and an empty-state UI with navigation to create a new thread.
frontend/src/pages/discussions/NewThread: Form for creating a new discussion thread with title, category, and content inputs.
frontend/src/pages/discussions/ThreadDet: Placeholder page for viewing discussion thread details.
frontend/src/pages/Downloads.tsx: Displays available Android and iOS mobile artifacts, enabling download and copyable direct URLs with status checks.
frontend/src/pages/events/EventDetail.ts: Placeholder page for viewing details of a specific event.
frontend/src/pages/events/Events.tsx: Displays upcoming events with filters and admin-only event creation button.
frontend/src/pages/events/NewEvent.tsx: Admin-protected form to create a new event with type, location, and description fields.
frontend/src/pages/HelpSupport.tsx: Shows safety resources, crisis info, community guidelines, and reporting instructions via cards and accordions.
frontend/src/pages/matches/Matches.tsx: Shows user matches, handles auth states, loading, errors, and links to swipe matching.
frontend/src/pages/matches/SwipeMatching: Implements swipe-based matching flow with candidate fetching, swipe recording, and match notifications.
frontend/src/pages/moderation/ModeratorD: Admin-only dashboard that lists reported confessions and allows moderators to update status and record moderation actions.
frontend/src/pages/OnboardingGate.tsx: Presents onboarding requirements with checkboxes for age and guideline confirmation before granting access.
frontend/src/pages/profile/Profile.tsx: Profile management page letting authenticated users view and edit personal details and preferences.
frontend/src/pages/resources/Resources.t: Displays a searchable, filterable list of mental health resources with category badges and external links.
frontend/src/pages/Settings.tsx: Provides user settings for privacy, notifications, and tour/reset actions with profile persistence.
frontend/src/utils/mobileArtifacts.ts: Defines mobile artifact paths and metadata and includes a helper to check if an artifact file exists via a HEAD request.
frontend/src/utils/privacy.ts: Utility functions for anonymizing labels, formatting timestamps, and redacting principals.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters, including sessionStorage handling and hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, fonts, shadows, animations, and container settings.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing state, features, and pending requests for mobile download link support.
